declarations.docstring: Data equipping a category with an abelian structure.
Constructs an abelian structure on a full subcategory of modules from the stated closure assumptions.
The essential image of a zero-object-preserving functor contains the zero object.
The essential image of an exact full faithful functor is closed under images.
The essential image of a full faithful functor is closed under cokernels when it preserves parallel-pair colimits.
The essential image of a full faithful colimit-preserving functor is closed under colimits of the given shape.
The essential image of a full faithful functor that preserves finite coproducts is closed under them.
The essential image of a full faithful functor that preserves finite products is closed under them.
The essential image of a full faithful functor is closed under kernels when it preserves parallel-pair limits.
The essential image of a full faithful limit-preserving functor is closed under limits of the given shape.
A colimit object lies in the essential image when every object of its diagram does.
A limit object lies in the essential image when every object of its diagram does.
Every abelian category is equivalent to a full subcategory of modules satisfying the displayed closure conditions.
The functor from an abelian category to modules over its associated ring.
The ring associated to an abelian category for its module representation.
The object property selecting modules in the represented subcategory.
The equivalence from an abelian category to the full subcategory of represented modules.
The natural isomorphism identifying the represented-subcategory inclusion after the equivalence with the representation functor.
The represented-module object property is closed under images.
